decisions.decision: Phase 02 concluded that native provider adapters are the runtime path, not Postiz-style reuse.
decisions.rationale: The comparison package found Postiz useful as a reference, but the LocalPilot-owned workflow boundary, redacted diagnostics, and approval gate fit native adapters better.

decisions.decision: Phase 03 uses clickable Facebook OAuth for the customer demo instead of asking users for access tokens.
decisions.rationale: Customers should grant access through Meta Login; tokens must remain backend-owned and hidden from browser storage.

decisions.decision: Phase 03 is reframed as Predis.ai replica plus LocalPilot proof-loop MVP.
decisions.rationale: The v3 research identifies Predis.ai as the closest US SMB competitor; LocalPilot needs recognizable parity plus owner approval and measurable local response evidence.

next_action: Continue Phase 03 with logged-in Predis screen audit if credentials are available, then choose the next real parity slice: notification provider delivery/webhooks, real source/page analysis ingestion, official/social API competitor ingestion, production platform analytics ingestion, production media/video renderer integration, live Canva/Figma/Adobe import, drag/drop editor controls, or production token hardening.
